subject: delegation hierarchy
scenario: A worker escalating straight to the head means the lead was not told about a problem in its own department. A head reading every review comment cannot see the department at all.
expected_behaviors: Escalation runs worker to peer to lead to head, never skipping the lead.
The head receives a rollup and is never also a worker.
The rollup is produced by the lead.
failure_conditions: A cycle lets a worker reach the head directly.
A head is listed among the workers of its own department.

checks.pattern: A worker never escalates straight to the head
